proposals.premise: Train connections and recipe steps both foreground the next feasible action. Route maps to connection, stop to step, and access or closing time to readiness.
proposals.opening: Desktop first shows two route cards beside the three licensed photographs; phone stacks them above one next-stop card. Timing, reachability, and preview status share that card.
proposals.move: Tap Direct or Step-free. The next reachable stop, arrival time, bridge pass-through warning, and available audio button update immediately below.
proposals.tradeoff: Fast comparison and familiar scanning; the photographs become supporting atmosphere rather than the main evening experience.

proposals.premise: Assume visitors are already outside, not studying a map. Checkout queues and airport gates foreground the next viable choice: bridge width maps to capacity, and 20:30 maps to closing.
proposals.opening: Phone first shows Start at square with a countdown and bell preview; desktop shares that panel with a compact route overview and the three photographs.
proposals.move: Tap Start. Direct and Step-free appear; choosing one replaces the panel with the next reachable stop, arrival time, warning, and only licensed previews.
proposals.tradeoff: Excellent while moving and makes the choir cutoff hard to miss; weaker for visitors wanting to compare the whole evening before starting.
